content: jose SignJWT/jwtVerify verified code patterns (github.com/panva/jose docs): new SignJWT(payload).setProtectedHeader({alg:'HS256'}).setIssuedAt().setExpirationTime('2h').sign(secret) where secret = new TextEncoder().encode(secretString). Verification: jose.jwtVerify(jwt, secret, {issuer, audience}) returns {payload, protectedHeader}. HS256 with TextEncoder-derived secret is the standard pattern for symmetric JWT session cookies.
